title: If you were a child living in Afghanistan, what would you do?
excerpt: Here’s what some Afghan children did … … seeking to make a connection with you and me. Have some tissues handy, and please pass this on to everyone you can. And then ask … if you were an adult (or whatever) living where you live, what would you do in response?
